name: Hotel Gasthof Schermer
beschreibung: Gasthof Schermer is situated in the centre of the spa village Bad Häring in the Kufstein district of Tyrol. The inn balances traditional hospitality with an informal, friendly atmosphere. Guest rooms are comfortably and functionally furnished, while the restaurant offers authentic Tyrolean home cooking at fair prices. Bad Häring serves as a scenic gateway for hiking trips throughout the Kaisergebirge range.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Schermer in Bad Häring combines relaxed family-run hospitality, functional rooms, hearty regional dining, and great access to Kaisergebirge trails.
